claims.quote: This will bring investment and good jobs, giving young people the chance to build their future in the place they call home.
claims.statement: The Derby headquarters will bring investment and good jobs to the city and give young people the chance to build their future there.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission - better services for passengers
claims.statement: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission of better services for passengers.

claims.quote: With 600 apprenticeships opening up, we’re investing not just in the railway of tomorrow, but in the people who will build it.
claims.statement: The government is investing in the people who will build the railway of tomorrow through the 600 apprenticeships.

claims.made_by: Work and Pensions Secretary Pat McFadden
claims.quote: This foundation apprenticeship will give young people the chance to explore career paths within the sector at an exciting time
claims.statement: The foundation apprenticeship will give young people the chance to explore career paths within the rail sector.

claims.made_by: Mayor of the East Midlands, Claire Ward
claims.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby.
claims.statement: The headquarters announcement is fantastic news for Derby.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of Great British Railways' headquarters was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026.

facts.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029
facts.statement: Construction of the headquarters at Becketwell, a brownfield site in Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

facts.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
facts.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

facts.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
facts.statement: The headquarters site will accommodate up to 450 Great British Railways staff.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.

facts.quote: the recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site
facts.statement: A £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north is set to be built at Alstom's Derby site.

facts.quote: less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
facts.statement: Less than 7% of the railway's workforce is under 25.
